description: Statelessness, driven by running one invocation three times: twice against a single service instance and once against a freshly constructed one. All three outcomes must be equal. WS-ERR-FLG, WS-MESSAGE, WS-OPTION and WS-IDX are WORKING-STORAGE in the COBOL, which under CICS is per-task; as fields of a Spring singleton they would be shared and the second caller would see the first caller's message. And CARDDEMO-COMMAREA travels in the request and the response payload at exactly the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares, never in server-side session state, which is the only reason the navigation context is comparable at all. Option 6 is chosen so the run ends in the XCTL at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:152-155, the path that mutates the most commarea fields and so has the most to leak.
